records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal year 2023 increased $116.4 million, or 42 percent, to $393.6 million from $277.3 million in the first quarter of fiscal year 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To date, any negative impact of COVID-19 on the overall demand for our products, cash flow from operations, need for capital expenditures, and our liquidity position has been limited.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The cash flow from operations during the first three months of fiscal year 2023 was related to the cash components of our net income and a $5.5 million favorable change in working capital, primarily as a result of a decrease in accounts receivables and increase in income taxes payable, partially offset by an increase in inventory and decrease in accounts payable and other accrued liabilities for the period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 51.5 percent in the first quarter of fiscal year 2023, up from 50.5 percent in the first quarter of fiscal year 2022.
